closing.title: Period Closing, Closing & Reversing Entries
closing.subtitle: Lock monthly accounting periods, run automated closing entries for nominal accounts to Retained Earnings, and execute period-start reversing entries.
closing.card_desc: Period closing automatically posts Closing Entries for Revenue & Expense accounts to Retained Earnings and locks the period.
closing.empty_desc: Open a new monthly period to begin recording journal entries and period closing.
closing.btn_auto_close: Close Period & Generate Auto Closing Entry
closing.confirm_close_title: Run Period Closing & Auto Closing Entry ({{name}})?
closing.confirm_close_desc: This process will automatically zero out all Revenue and Expense account balances in period {{name}} to Retained Earnings (3-1201) via a Closing Entry, and lock the period from new transactions.
closing.toast_closed_success: Period closing & Closing Entry for {{name}} executed successfully.

closing.reopen_reason_placeholder: e.g. Late month-end bank reconciliation adjustment received...

closing.manual_desc_placeholder: e.g. Period-end closing of revenue and expense account balances
closing.toast_manual_min_lines: Add at least 1 debit account and 1 credit account.
closing.toast_manual_unbalanced: Total Debit and Total Credit of the closing entry must be balanced and greater than Rp0.
closing.toast_manual_error: Failed to post manual closing entry.
closing.rev_source_period_label: Source Period (Source of Auto-Reverse Adjusting Entries)
closing.rev_date_label: Reversing Entry Date (Start of New Period)
closing.toast_rev_select_period: Select the source period of adjusting entries to reverse.
closing.toast_rev_none: No unreversed auto-reverse adjusting entries found in the selected period.
closing.detail_empty_journals: No closing entries in this period (no revenue/expense account balances when period was closed).
closing.page_subtitle: List of actual closing entries stored in the system and accounting period management.
closing.tab_subheading: List of actual closing entries stored in the system and accounting period controls.
closing.flow_subtitle: 4-step guide for closing nominal account balances at the end of an accounting period.
closing.step1_desc: Debit all Revenue accounts and credit Income Summary (3500) for the total revenue amount.
closing.step2_desc: Debit Income Summary (3500) and credit all Expense accounts for their respective total expenses.
closing.step3_desc: Close the net balance of Income Summary to Retained Earnings (3201) (net income: debit Income Summary & credit Retained Earnings; net loss: reverse).
closing.step4_desc: Debit Retained Earnings (3201) and credit Owner's Drawings (3301) to zero out capital withdrawals.
closing.auto_banner_on_desc: The system is configured to automatically post GAAP/IFRS closing entries when a period is closed. You can still record manual closing adjustments below.
closing.auto_banner_off_desc: Automated period closing is currently disabled in Super Admin Settings.
closing.table_card_desc: Historical nominal account closing journal entries stored in the bookkeeping system.
closing.empty_closing_title: No actual closing entries in this period
closing.empty_closing_desc: Use the 'Record Manual Closing Entry' button or run automated period closing when closing a monthly period.
